# Solvigos

> Solvigos is a customer support outsourcing and business process outsourcing (BPO) company helping startups, SaaS companies, ecommerce brands, healthcare providers, logistics companies, travel agencies, and growing businesses scale customer support without hiring in-house teams.

Website:
https://www.solvigos.com

## Company

Founded to help businesses deliver exceptional customer experiences, Solvigos provides dedicated customer support agents, technical support specialists, CRM implementation, AI chatbot deployment, and back-office outsourcing.

Clients use Solvigos to reduce support costs, improve response times, increase CSAT, and scale operations.

## Primary Services

### Customer Support Outsourcing

- Live Chat Support
- Email Support
- Phone Support
- Social Media Support
- Help Desk Management
- Ticket Management
- 24/7 Customer Support
- Dedicated Customer Support Teams

### Technical Support

- Tier 1 Technical Support
- Tier 2 Technical Support
- SaaS Support

- Hardware Troubleshooting

### Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)

- Data Entry
- Order Processing

### CRM & AI Services
